name: Dify v1 AI App Studio
description: Visual agent & RAG builder with plugins, code sandbox, workers and vector DB.

PORT.description: Port nginx listens on (public domain target).

DIFY_PLUGIN_DAEMON_UPSTREAM.description: Plugin Daemon private address (/e/ plugin endpoints).

NGINX_CLIENT_MAX_BODY_SIZE.description: Max upload size through the gateway.

SERVER_CONSOLE_API_URL.description: Private API URL for server-side rendering requests.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL.description: Public WebSocket origin for collaboration (update with a custom domain).

NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_AGENT_V2.description: Show the Agent (v2) builder, backed by Agent Backend + Agent Sandbox.

TOP_K_MAX_VALUE.description: Max retrieval top-k in the UI.

INDEXING_MAX_SEGMENTATION_TOKENS_LENGTH.description: Max chunk length for knowledge indexing.

ALLOW_EMBED.description: Allow embedding the console in iframes (published apps are always embeddable).

PORT.description: Port Railway health-checks and routes to.

DIFY_BIND_ADDRESS.description: Bind on IPv4+IPv6 so the private network can reach it.

SERVER_WORKER_AMOUNT.description: Gunicorn worker processes (raise with more RAM/CPU).

GUNICORN_TIMEOUT.description: Request timeout in seconds (long streaming responses).

MIGRATION_ENABLED.description: Run database migrations on boot (only this service migrates).

INIT_PASSWORD.description: Password required on /install before the first admin account can be created. Read it from this variable.

SECRET_KEY.description: Flask signing/encryption key. Shared by API, WebSocket, Worker and Beat. Never change after first boot.

DIFY_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public base URL of this Dify instance (the Gateway). Change here when you add a custom domain.

CONSOLE_API_URL.description: Public URL of the console API (same origin via Gateway).

CONSOLE_WEB_URL.description: Public URL of the console web UI.

SERVICE_API_URL.description: Base URL shown for the Service API (/v1).

APP_API_URL.description: Public URL of the web-app API.

APP_WEB_URL.description: Public URL of published web apps.

FILES_URL.description: Public prefix for signed file preview/download links.

TRIGGER_URL.description: Public prefix for workflow trigger webhooks.

INTERNAL_FILES_URL.description: Private URL used by Plugin Daemon and Agent services to fetch files.

ENDPOINT_URL_TEMPLATE.description: Public URL template for plugin endpoints (routed by the Gateway to Plugin Daemon).

CONSOLE_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS.description: Allowed origins for the console API (same origin by default).

WEB_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS.description: Allowed origins for the public web-app API (embeds need *).

ENABLE_COLLABORATION_MODE.description: Real-time collaborative workflow editing via the API WebSocket service.

SQLALCHEMY_POOL_SIZE.description: DB pool size per process (kept below Postgres' default 100 connections across all services).

SQLALCHEMY_MAX_OVERFLOW.description: Extra DB connections allowed above the pool size.

SQLALCHEMY_POOL_PRE_PING.description: Validate pooled connections before use (survives idle network resets).

SQLALCHEMY_POOL_RECYCLE.description: Recycle DB connections after N seconds.

STORAGE_TYPE.description: File storage backend: Railway Bucket via the S3 API.

S3_ADDRESS_STYLE.description: S3 addressing style. Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted style; set 'path' only if the bucket's Credentials tab says so.

S3_USE_AWS_MANAGED_IAM.description: Use static keys, not AWS IAM roles.

VECTOR_STORE.description: Vector database used for knowledge bases.

SSRF_PROXY_HTTP_URL.description: SSRF proxy for outbound HTTP from workflows/tools.

SSRF_PROXY_HTTPS_URL.description: SSRF proxy for outbound HTTPS from workflows/tools.

PLUGIN_DAEMON_KEY.description: Key the API uses to call Plugin Daemon.

INNER_API_KEY_FOR_PLUGIN.description: Key Plugin Daemon / Agent Backend use to call the API's inner endpoints.

PLUGIN_MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE.description: Max plugin package size in bytes.

AGENT_BACKEND_API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for the Agent backend control plane.

DB_DATABASE.description: Plugin database (created automatically on first boot).

PLUGIN_STORAGE_TYPE.description: Plugin packages are kept on this service's volume.

MAX_PLUGIN_PACKAGE_SIZE.description: Max plugin package size in bytes.

PYTHON_ENV_INIT_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout (s) to build a plugin's Python environment.

PLUGIN_REMOTE_INSTALLING_HOST.description: Remote plugin-debugging listener (needs a TCP proxy on 5003 to be used).

PIP_MIRROR_URL.description: Optional PyPI mirror for plugin installs.

API_KEY.description: Key the API uses to call the code sandbox.

ENABLE_NETWORK.description: Allow sandboxed code to make network calls (through the SSRF proxy).

PIP_MIRROR_URL.description: Optional PyPI mirror for extra Python packages.

SSRF_PROXY_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS.description: Optional comma-separated CIDRs that workflows may reach despite the private-network block.

SSRF_PROXY_ALLOW_PRIVATE_DOMAINS.description: Optional comma-separated domains (e.g. .railway.internal) that workflows may reach.

DIFY_AGENT_API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token the API uses for the Agent control plane.

DIFY_AGENT_SERVER_SECRET_KEY.description: Root secret (43-char base64url = 32 bytes) for Agent Stub token encryption.

DIFY_AGENT_RUNTIME_BACKEND.description: Sandbox backend: local (Agent Sandbox service) or e2b.

DIFY_AGENT_LOCAL_SANDBOX_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Token shared with the Agent Sandbox.

DIFY_AGENT_STUB_API_BASE_URL.description: Agent Stub URL the sandbox calls (through Agent SSRF Proxy).

DIFY_AGENT_SANDBOX_FILES_BASE_URL.description: API base for sandbox file transfers (/files/*).

HTTP_PROXY.description: Egress via the agent SSRF proxy.

HTTPS_PROXY.description: Egress via the agent SSRF proxy.

SHELLCTL_ENABLE_PATH_ISOLATION.description: Landlock path isolation for agent shell jobs. Set false only if jobs fail with Landlock errors.

SSRF_PROXY_MODE.description: Policy: agent = only Agent Stub + API /files/* on the private network, internet otherwise.

SSRF_PROXY_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS.description: Optional extra private CIDRs the agent may reach.

SSRF_PROXY_ALLOW_PRIVATE_DOMAINS.description: Optional extra private domains the agent may reach.

CLUSTER_HOSTNAME.description: Stable node name; do not change after first boot.

AUTHENTICATION_APIKEY_USERS.description: User mapped to the API key.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down

REDISHOST.description: Private network hostname of the Redis service, only resolvable from services in the same environment

REDIS_URL.description: Connection string for connecting to Redis using the private network

REDISPASSWORD.description: Alias of REDIS_PASSWORD for clients that expect the unseparated name

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Randomly generated password for authenticating with Redis
